read.title: Responding to Negative Reviews
read.text:
A quick, polite reply to a negative review can win back a customer and show future buyers that you care. Reply within 24 hours if possible.

Start by thanking the customer and saying you are sorry to hear about the problem. Do not argue or blame the delivery company. Then offer a clear next step, such as a replacement or a refund, and ask the customer to reach out through Amazon messages.

Never ask a customer to change or remove a review in exchange for a refund. This is against Amazon policy.

write.model: Hi Sarah, we're sorry to hear that your toner arrived broken, and we apologize for the inconvenience. We would be happy to send you a replacement or issue a full refund, whichever you prefer. Please reach out to us through Amazon messages with your order number, and we will take care of it right away.
